source_title: Is Neil McCann's Kilmarnock style 'unsustainable'? - BBC
source_excerpt:
Former Kilmarnock goalkeeper Cammy Bell believes boss Neil McCann's expansive style is "unsustainable".
McCann saved the club from relegation last term but they have failed to kick on in the new campaign.
Kilmarnock currently sit bottom of the Premiership with only two wins out of their opening 11 league fixtures and 26 goals conceded.
Not only that, they have faced the most shots, shots on target, given away the most big chances and scored the joint fewest goals.
As pressure builds on McCann among the Kilmarnock support, Cammy Bell told the BBC's Scottish Football Podcast what he thinks is going wrong for his former club.
"They need to stop conceding goals. You look at the amount of goals that they've conceded already this season and that has been a theme since McCann came in," said Bell.
"He's quite expansive in the style he wants to play. They've conceded 26 goals, that is just unsustainable to win games.
"You will not win games if you concede that many goals. They've only scored 11, so that tells you Kilmarnock why they are bottom. It's not good enough at the moment.
"McCann needs to turn things around quickly because the fans are now starting to question what direction Kilmarnock are going in. He needs to get some points on the board quickly."

## वर्तमान स्थिति
किलमारनॉक वर्तमान में स्कॉटिश प्रीमियरशिप तालिका में सबसे निचले पायदान पर है। सीजन के शुरुआती 11 लीग मैचों में केवल दो जीत हासिल करने के बाद, मैनेजर नील मैककैन पर प्रदर्शन सुधारने का दबाव लगातार बढ़ रहा है।

## सांख्यिकीय चिंताएं
टीम के मौजूदा प्रदर्शन के आंकड़े मैककैन की आक्रामक और खुली खेल शैली की प्रभावशीलता पर सवाल उठाते हैं:
* **रक्षात्मक कमजोरी:** टीम ने शुरुआती 11 मैचों में कुल 26 गोल खाए हैं।
* **आक्रामक प्रदर्शन:** किलमारनॉक ने अब तक केवल 11 गोल किए हैं, जो लीग में सबसे कम है।
* **शॉट्स का सामना:** रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, किलमारनॉक को लीग में सबसे अधिक शॉट्स और 'बिग चांसेस' का सामना करना पड़ा है।

## विशेषज्ञ की राय
पूर्व किलमारनॉक गोलकीपर कैमी बेल ने बीबीसी के स्कॉटिश फुटबॉल पॉडकास्ट पर इस खेल शैली को 'अस्थिर' (unsustainable) बताया है। बेल का मानना है कि इतने अधिक गोल खाने के कारण मैच जीतना असंभव है। उन्होंने कहा कि मैनेजर को तुरंत अपनी रक्षात्मक रणनीति में बदलाव करने की आवश्यकता है ताकि टीम को अंकों की तालिका में ऊपर लाया जा सके।

## परिणाम और आगे की राह
प्रशंसकों के बीच बढ़ते असंतोष के बीच, अगले कुछ मैच मैककैन के भविष्य के लिए महत्वपूर्ण माने जा रहे हैं। टीम चयन या आगामी मैचों के आधिकारिक कार्यक्रम की पुष्टि के लिए, समर्थक आधिकारिक क्लब वेबसाइट और स्कॉटिश प्रोफेशनल फुटबॉल लीग (SPFL) के पोर्टल को देख सकते हैं।

## Current Status
Kilmarnock is currently at the bottom of the Scottish Premiership table. Following 11 league fixtures, the club has managed only two victories, placing significant pressure on manager Neil McCann.

## Statistical Concerns
The team's performance metrics have raised concerns regarding the sustainability of McCann's tactical approach:
* **Defensive Fragility:** The club has conceded 26 goals in their opening 11 matches.
* **Offensive Output:** Kilmarnock has scored only 11 goals, tying for the lowest in the league.
* **Shot Statistics:** Reports indicate the team has faced the highest number of total shots and shots on target, alongside giving away the most significant goal-scoring opportunities in the competition.

## Expert Perspective
Former Kilmarnock goalkeeper Cammy Bell, appearing on the BBC's Scottish Football Podcast, characterized the current expansive style of play as "unsustainable." Bell argued that the high volume of goals conceded makes it mathematically difficult to secure points. He emphasized that the primary challenge for the coaching staff is to stabilize the defense immediately to reverse the club's current trajectory.

## Implications
As fan frustration grows, the upcoming fixtures are critical for McCann. To verify further updates regarding team selection or match schedules, supporters should monitor official club channels and the Scottish Professional Football League (SPFL) match center.
